title: My School Has One Rule: Never Look Into Room 9 After The Bell
cta: Tag a friend who is always late
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story. Would you have broken the rule? Tell us in the comments.
lines: Never look into Room 9 after the last bell.
The door is always locked. The window is painted black.
Yesterday, I forgot my bag. The bell rang.
A bit of the paint had scratched off.
A full class, sitting in silence.
They were all writing my name.
Then they turned. All at once.
